method: One fresh Firefox process per scheduler, no inference warm-up. Feed the JFK fixture as 512-sample packets with a 32 ms browser timer, using the real WASM worker. Desktop CPU; simulated capture, not Android or physical microphone latency. Compare first nonempty transcript only; Stop occurred at different times after the fixture ended.

environment.userAgent: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64; rv:155.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/155.0

baseline.scheduler: LiveSegmenter from commit 2f45868; original fixed RMS threshold and eight-second cap; no previews

revised.scheduler: short-phrases-v1; three-second target, adaptive RMS threshold, no previews
